papers.title: A first-principles approach to closing the "10-100 eV gap" for charge-carrier thermalization in semiconductors
papers.summary: The present work is concerned with studying accurately the energy-loss processes that control the thermalization of hot electrons and holes that are generated by high-energy radiation in wurtzite GaN, using an ab initio approach. Current physical models of the nuclear/particle physics community cover thermalization in the high-energy range (kinetic energies exceeding ~100 eV), and the electronic-device community has studied extensively carrier transport in the low-energy range (below ~10 eV).
